ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, within $ \triangle ABC$, $DE \parallel BC$, $AD=9$, $DB=3$, and $DE=6$. What is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $DE \parallel BC$, \\
then $\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC$, \\
hence $\frac{AD}{AB} = \frac{DE}{BC}$, \\
since $AD = 9$, and $DB = 3$, \\
then AB = AD + BD = 12, \\
also, because $DE = 6$, \\
therefore, $\frac{9}{12} = \frac{6}{BC}$, \\
thus, BC = \boxed{8}.
